dialog.title: Pending uploads
dialog.offlineDescription: You are offline. Notes and activities you create are saved on this device and sent when the connection is back.
dialog.onlineDescription: Notes and activities created offline are sent automatically, only once.

conflicts.title: Could not send
conflicts.description: The server rejected these items. Fix what is needed and try again, or discard them.
conflicts.discardDescription: "{{label}}" will be removed from this device and will not be sent.

reasons.expired: The server did not confirm it for too long. Check whether it was already created before trying again.
reasons.validation: The data was rejected by validation.
reasons.forbidden: You are no longer allowed to create this item.
reasons.notFound: The linked record no longer exists.
